gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.summary: 6/6 DAMAGED non-OLMo arms land at/below their own best-constant floor 0.2689. Llama-2 k8 0.2415 (-2.74pp), Llama-3 k8 0.2329 (-3.60), Qwen3 k8 0.2286 (-4.03), Llama-2 k12 0.2295 (-3.94), Llama-3 k12 0.2527 (-1.62), Qwen3 k12 0.2300 (-3.89). gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.mechanism_finding: The collapse ROUTE differs by family but the OUTCOME does not. Non-OLMo damaged arms become constant-letter emitters with NEAR-ZERO exact ties (Llama-2 k12 is 100.0% modal with 0.00% ties; Qwen3 k12 is 99.1% modal with 0.03% ties). OLMo damaged arms reach the same place via 30.64% exact ties + argmax index tie-breaking. So ties are ONE road, not THE mechanism -- this over-determines the gate-3 refutation.
gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.content_also_fails: every damaged arm has content_norm within +/-3pp of its letter accuracy and both hover at their floors -- switching interface does NOT rescue a damaged arm
gate1_third_model_family_DAMAGED.scope_narrowed_20260810: The 'A01_GENERAL_CLAIM_CONFIRMED' label overstates what these six arms show. They are EXTREME FRONT-TRUNCATION at k8/k12 with NO fresh block and NO heal. Correct scope: 'extreme front-truncation with no heal, in four families' plus one healed OLMo-2 keep8 arm from a different regime. The audit's counterexample stands and is recorded: OLMo-2 HEALED keep8 has content_norm 0.342259, clearly ABOVE the split null 0.284450 (+5.78pp, boot p=0.0001), so 'switching interface does NOT rescue a damaged arm' is true of the six pure-truncation non-OLMo arms and FALSE of that healed arm.

gate1_depth_curve.why_it_matters: Supplies a mechanism-free version of A01's protocol argument. Below threshold the letter interface IS a constant predictor; above it, a competent one. Averaging arms that straddle the threshold mixes two regimes. Any damage-scaling regression on letter accuracy that includes sub-threshold rungs is fitting a step, and its slope is an artifact of how many rungs land on each side. This also EXPLAINS the 6/6 damaged result: those arms were keep8/keep12, deep inside every family's sub-threshold range.

full_replication_20260811.ran: 2026-08-11, task #248, .73 8xH20, ~11 min, 36 arm x task cells
full_replication_20260811.what_it_adds: The 2026-08-08 leg's interfaces were raw sum-LL vs length-normalised acc_norm. This run builds MMLU's EXACT letter-vs-content contrast (letter prompt = content prompt with the labelled A./B./C./D. body spliced in before '\nAnswer:', verified byte-for-byte in the harness selftest) on five non-MMLU MC benchmarks + winogrande as control. The 'analogous but not identical interface contrast' caveat below is therefore SUPERSEDED for these tasks -- but the caveat is retained above because it correctly describes the 2026-08-08 leg.

benchmarks_and_letter_floors.honesty_note: These letter floors are only +0.43 to +2.60pp above chance -- much flatter than BoolQ's 0.6217-vs-0.50. Do NOT reuse paperG's 'chance badly misstates the null' rhetoric on the letter side of these five; the dramatic cases stay BoolQ (letter-ish) and OpenBookQA (content).

what_replicated: The construct-validity claim, on 5/5 evidence tasks: of the 15 damaged arm x task cells (keep12/keep10/keep8 x 5 tasks), 10 sit ABOVE their naive chance line and 0 clear their own best-constant floor. Ten cells flip verdict under the correct null. NOT 15/15 above chance -- the honest count is 10/15 flipped, 0/15 above floor.
The arm ordering and the floor-arrival point: keep14 is the last arm above its floor on 4/5 (PIQA has already reached it), keep12 and below are at/under the floor on 5/5.

The tie-convention reversal: on arc_challenge all six arms are significantly ABOVE the content floor under split/first/last/wrong, and five of six flip to significantly BELOW under 'credit'. Same shape as MMLU's credit-flips-5/6.

Point-estimate direction: 12 of the 15 damaged letter deltas are negative (arc_easy 3/3, obqa 3/3, arc_ch 2/3, csqa 2/3, piqa 2/3). Descriptive exact binomial p=0.018 -- NOT a licensed inference (the 15 tests share items, nested arms and a common null).
full_replication_20260811.what_did_NOT_replicate: The SIGNIFICANT below-floor letter verdict. MMLU's headline is keep8 at -1.389pp p=0.019. Of the five non-MMLU tasks only arc_easy produces any significant below-floor arm, and it is keep10 (-2.694pp, boot p=0.0290, McNemar p=0.0320), not keep8. On keep8 itself no non-MMLU task reaches p<0.05.
full_replication_20260811.power_caveat_MANDATORY: 4 of the 5 evidence tasks are UNDERPOWERED to detect MMLU's own effect. Achieved CI95 half-width on the keep8-vs-floor test: MMLU 1.154pp (n=14042) | arc_easy 1.305pp | winogrande 1.184pp | piqa 2.775pp | commonsense_qa 3.399pp | arc_challenge 3.882pp | openbookqa 6.400pp (4.6x the effect). So 'keep8 is AT the floor on arc_challenge' is a NON-OBSERVATION, not counter-evidence. This table MUST accompany any citation of a null result from the smaller sets.
full_replication_20260811.new_finding_readout_dissociation: arc_easy keep8 is AT its letter floor (0.258418) while scoring 0.646044 on content_norm -- +38.763pp, exact McNemar p=9.8e-148, and above the content floor under all five conventions. The competence is present; the letter readout cannot express it. This is a STRONGER readout-vs-knowledge dissociation than MMLU provides.
full_replication_20260811.FALSIFIES_confirmed_general_2: claim_scope_after_gates.confirmed_general[2] ('content_norm sits within +/-3pp of letter on every damaged arm') is FALSE as a general statement and must be re-scoped to MMLU. keep8 content-minus-letter: arc_easy +38.76pp, csqa +22.77pp, piqa +19.15pp, arc_ch +9.64pp, obqa +8.20pp (MMLU itself is +8.72pp).
full_replication_20260811.NEW_degree_of_freedom_length_unit: The longest-option null has a SECOND under-specification on top of the tie convention: the LENGTH UNIT. The published acc_norm/norm_lens pipeline normalises by len(text) in CHARACTERS; the MMLU letter/content harness normalises by continuation-TOKEN count. Recomputed on identical items, split convention: obqa 0.363500(char) vs 0.368000(token); arc_ch 0.274104 vs 0.283902; arc_easy 0.255296 vs 0.238054; csqa 0.221977 vs 0.201775; piqa 0.475245 vs 0.465452; winogrande 0.491713 vs 0.501184. The 'credit' convention is far more unit-sensitive (delta up to +0.352 on winogrande, +0.228 on obqa). CONSEQUENCE: the protocol sentence must become 'report a construct-appropriate null AND print its convention AND its length unit'. Extends confirmed_general[5]; nothing retracted.
full_replication_20260811.obqa_0_3635_is_a_CHARACTER_length_null: paperG/README.md and this record publish OpenBookQA's longest-option floor as 0.3635. That is correct AS A CHARACTER-LENGTH null. The token-unit value on identical items is 0.368000. Label the unit; where OBQA appears next to an MMLU number prefer 0.3680 so the units match. NOT a retraction.
full_replication_20260811.winogrande_control_quantified: The old record's '100% tie rate, acc==acc_norm exactly' is a property of the PUBLISHED partial-scoring construction. Rebuilt label-free like every other task here, winogrande is only PARTIALLY degenerate: 86.50% of items still have identical continuation-token counts, acc==acc_norm on 94.6-96.8% of items, split null 0.501184 (not exactly 0.5). Its 'credit' null is 0.933702 -- a length heuristic with oracle tie-breaking beats the full base model (0.580110) by 35pp. Still a NEGATIVE CONTROL ONLY, now with a quantitative reason rather than an assumption. Its keep8 letter modal share is 0.9534 (a near-constant emitter) yet the floor verdict is AT (+0.552pp p=0.357).
full_replication_20260811.modal_share_floor_decoupling_reconfirmed: Consistent with NARROWED_20260810_constant_predictor and if anything wider: arc_challenge keep8 modal 0.8038 -> only AT the floor (-0.939pp p=0.644); arc_challenge keep10 modal 0.3848 with a POSITIVE delta (+1.621pp); winogrande keep8 modal 0.9534 -> AT; piqa keep12 modal 0.8781 -> AT.
full_replication_20260811.residual_fraction_inflation: OpenBookQA content_norm base: 22.4% under the token-longest floor vs 47.3% under chance = 2.11x inflation (replicates the 2.15x from the 2026-08-08 leg; the small difference is the length-unit change). BUT piqa (0.90x) and arc_easy (0.98x) go the OTHER way -- their token-longest floors are below chance, so the chance line UNDERSTATES the residual there. 'Chance inflates the claim' is construct-specific, not universal; state it symmetrically.
full_replication_20260811.acc_vs_accnorm_sign_flips: arc_challenge 1/15, piqa 1/15, winogrande 1/15, arc_easy 0/15, obqa 0/15, csqa 0/15. Attributed in the JSON as a REPLICATION under damage of Oostermeijer ICML 2026 (arXiv:2607.12767), NOT a paperG finding.
full_replication_20260811.shard_integrity: 36/36 cells: 8/8 shards, n_scored == expected exactly (1172/2376/500/1221/1838/1267), n_nan == 0, n_trunc == 0. Asserted twice (harness merge RAISES on a partial set; analysis loader re-asserts). Failure grep over 60 logs with failure syntax: zero hits.
full_replication_20260811.cross_validation: Content prompts for arc_challenge/arc_easy/commonsense_qa are BYTE-IDENTICAL (1172/1172, 2376/2376, 1221/1221 verified programmatically) to eval_olmo2_probe2_downstream.py::load_task_examples, so content_raw must reproduce the published 'correct' field -- it agrees at 99.41-99.96% item-level, accuracy within 0.30pp, with disagreements only on near-ties (median top1-top2 gap 0.012-0.048). OpenBookQA deliberately deviates (0/500): the published loader uses the bare question_stem with NO 'Answer:' cue, which cannot host a letter interface; the 85-87% agreement is the size of that prompt effect.

the_one_flip_keep12_MARGINAL.do_not_overclaim: ONE arm of six; the fp32 CI clears zero by 0.078pp; p=0.0272 is UNCORRECTED and would not survive BH across the six arms. the_one_flip_keep12_MARGINAL.modal_shift_cuts_the_other_way: keep12's modal-letter concentration RISES under fp32: D@49.3% -> D@61.3%. So fp32 nudges accuracy up while making the arm a MORE degenerate constant predictor. The two move in opposite directions.

gate3_fp32_causal_tie_test.headline_3_fp32_makes_damaged_arms_more_: modal concentration rises under fp32 on every damaged arm: keep10 D 60.1->65.1%, keep12 D 49.3->61.3%, keep8 C 48.8->55.9%. gate3_fp32_causal_tie_test.base_arm_result: fp32 removes ALL exact ties (18 -> 0) but letter acc is UNCHANGED: 0.6054 both dtypes, delta +0.0000 CI95 [-0.0011,+0.0011], McNemar p=1.000. 96 letter argmax flips (0.68%), of which only 12 were the bf16-tied items. fixed_2026_08_11.root_cause_verified: NOT merely a missing clamp. `2*min((bs<=0).mean(),(bs>=0).mean())` double-counts the resamples whose mean is EXACTLY 0, because `<=` and `>=` both include them; hence (bs<=0).mean()+(bs>=0).mean() == 1 + (bs==0).mean() and the doubled smaller tail can exceed 1. `d = Lf - Lb` is a difference of two 0/1 correctness vectors, so it is integer-valued with 13986/14042 exact zeros on the base arm and the bootstrap mean lands exactly on 0 for 5.44% of resamples -- measured on the real per-example shards, which reproduce p_old = 1.0420 bit-for-bit.
fixed_2026_08_11.fix: new shared helper two_sided_boot_p() in code/a01_gate3_fp32_vs_bf16.py splits the zero atom evenly between the tails (mid-p / half-correction): p_lo = P(bs<0) + 0.5*P(bs==0), p_hi = P(bs>0) + 0.5*P(bs==0) (these sum to exactly 1), p = min(1, 2*min(p_lo,p_hi)) further floored at 1/n_boot. Upper bound is now STRUCTURAL, not a truncation. Used by BOTH the contrast p and paired_bootstrap() (which fed every *_vs_null_boot_p and had the same double-counting bug, clamped only from below).
